pageProps.review: Location of the Mushroom Postcard in Odense, Region of Southern Denmark. The address is Stærmosegårdsvej, Odense, Region of Southern Denmark. If it doesn't appear on its own, turn on the seedling detector and move around the area bit by bit to find it.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` October 2026, around autumn, here is the Mushroom Postcard in Odense, Region of Southern Denmark. Mario is smiling broadly against the background of the sky. With his red cap and mustache, he looks like he popped right out of a fairy tale. The Pikmin standing next to him also wears a Mario cap, blending in perfectly. It feels as if childhood memories of the game are returning through a single postcard. ```adcard ```
